title: Non-IT Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Executive
description:
Shivoham Infosolutions LLP is a leading recruitment and staffing consultancy with over 22 years of experience in providing IT and Non-IT talent acquisition solutions across India. We partner with organizations across multiple industries to provide customized recruitment solutions and help them identify, attract and hire the right talent. We are looking for an enthusiastic and result-oriented Non-IT Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Executive to join our recruitment team. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment activities for various Non-IT positions across different industries. Job Overview The Non-IT Recruiter will be responsible for understanding client requirements, sourcing relevant candidates, screening resumes, conducting initial telephonic interviews, coordinating interviews with clients, following up with candidates and ensuring successful closures. The ideal candidate should have experience in Non-IT recruitment, excellent communication skills, strong sourcing capabilities and the ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously. Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Recruitment Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for Non-IT positions. Understand and analyze job descriptions received from clients. Identify suitable candidates based on job specifications, experience, qualifications and salary requirements. Handle multiple open positions and ensure timely closures. Work on junior, mid-level and senior-level hiring requirements. 2. Candidate Sourcing Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, social media, job portals, references and internal databases. Identify relevant profiles matching client requirements. Build and maintain a strong candidate database for current and future requirements. Use effective search techniques and Boolean searches to identify suitable candidates. Proactively source candidates for urgent and niche requirements. 3. Resume Screening & Initial Interviews Review and shortlist resumes based on job descriptions. Conduct initial telephonic interviews and assess candidate suitability. Evaluate candidates based on technical knowledge, experience, communication skills and career expectations. Check current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and availability. Explain job opportunities and company requirements.
